cases.sentence: Но только тебе и твоим сыновьям можно исполнять ___ во всем, что связано с жертвенником и с тем, что за завесой.
cases.explain: «священнические обязанности» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

cases.sentence: Тебе будет доставаться та часть самых ___, которую не предают огню.
cases.explain: «священных жертвоприношений» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

cases.sentence: Во всех самых священных приношениях, которые приносят Мне в дар, будь то ___, жертва за грех или жертва повинности, эта часть принадлежит тебе и твоим сыновьям.
cases.explain: «хлебное приношение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

cases.sentence: Я отдаю тебе все лучшее оливковое масло, ___ и зерно, которые приносят Господу, как первые плоды урожая.
cases.explain: «молодое вино» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Я отдаю тебе все лучшее оливковое масло, молодое вино и зерно, которые приносят Господу, как ___ урожая.
cases.explain: «первые плоды» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Но выкупай любого сына-первенца и любого первородного самца из ___.
cases.explain: «нечистых животных» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

cases.sentence: Но не выкупай ___, овец или коз; они священны.
cases.explain: «первородных волов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Все ___, которые израильтяне приносят Господу, Я отдаю тебе и твоим сыновьям и дочерям как вашу постоянную долю.
cases.explain: «священные приношения» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”

cases.sentence: Это ___ соли между Господом, тобой и твоим потомством.
cases.explain: «вечный завет» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”

cases.explain: «грядущих поколений» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.
